name: Missing Superposition Event
hint: When a superposition block changes an actor's state, that actor needs a non-empty handler for the superposition-start event. Without it, no response to the new state is defined and the program may appear to do nothing.
instruction: Add a non-empty [when superposition started] handler to the affected actor and define its behavior for the superposed state there.
